categories.main_business_segments: The company specializes in the R&D, design, production, and sales of high-precision, high-density, complex-shaped, and aesthetically refined precision components. Its main product lines include Metal Injection Molding (MIM) products, other metal process products and plastic products, and mold tooling and equipment. The products are primarily customized and serve sectors such as consumer electronics, automotive, medical, and other tools.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced manufacturing technologies including Metal Injection Molding (MIM), high-precision wire cutting, CNC machining, laser processing, high-speed continuous stamping, and precision injection molding. It actively invests in new materials like titanium alloys and emerging technologies such as 3D printing to enhance product performance and expand its manufacturing capabilities. The company also emphasizes automation and digitalization in production to improve efficiency and quality.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are leading domestic and international consumer electronics brands and their EMS manufacturers, including Apple, Honor, Amazon, and Anker Innovations. The products are widely used in new consumer electronics such as foldable smartphones, tablets, laptops, smart styluses, wearable devices (TWS earbuds, smart glasses, smartwatches), drones, and other smart devices. The company focuses on high-end, technology-driven markets with strong demand for precision components.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters and major production facilities in Shenzhen and other locations including a new factory in Changsha, Hunan, and an overseas factory in Vietnam. It serves both domestic and international markets, benefiting from China's dual circulation strategy. It also has subsidiaries and business presence in Hong Kong, the United States, and Vietnam.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates mainly in the midstream segment of the supply chain, focusing on the manufacturing of precision components and parts. It acts as a key supplier and development partner to brand owners and EMS providers, integrating R&D and production to deliver customized solutions. It does not primarily engage in raw material extraction or end-product assembly but provides critical components for downstream manufacturers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategically, the company prioritizes innovation-driven growth, focusing on new materials application (especially lightweight titanium alloys), 3D printing technology, and AI-driven industry transformation. It invests heavily in R&D to develop differentiated technical solutions and expand its product portfolio. The company also emphasizes multi-diversification of business lines, expanding customer base, and enhancing production capacity domestically and internationally to capture emerging market opportunities.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of customized precision components to EMS providers designated by brand owners. The company engages early in product design and development phases with customers, securing orders for mass production. Revenue streams include sales of MIM products, other metal and plastic components, and mold tooling and equipment, with a focus on volume-based product sales.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company holds a leading position in the precision components manufacturing industry, recognized as a national-level specialized and innovative 'Little Giant' enterprise. It competes with other advanced precision manufacturing firms in China and globally, leveraging its strong R&D capabilities, diversified manufacturing technologies, and strategic partnerships with top-tier consumer electronics brands. Its competitive edge lies in technology innovation, product quality, and customer collaboration.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved revenue of approximately RMB 814 million, representing a 44.93% year-over-year growth. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 74.63 million, up 26.99%. The company crossed the USD 100 million revenue threshold, marking a significant scale milestone. It has shown strong cash flow growth and continues to invest substantially in R&D, with R&D expenses accounting for nearly 12% of revenue.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes delivering innovative, high-precision, and customized component solutions that meet evolving customer needs in high-tech consumer electronics. Its value proposition includes advanced manufacturing technologies, comprehensive technical solutions, high product quality, reliable delivery, and strong collaborative R&D partnerships. The focus on new materials and additive manufacturing positions it to offer differentiated, lightweight, and high-performance components that support customers' product innovation and market competitiveness.
